title: Accounts Payable Analyst
description:
Accounts Payable Analyst

6 month FTC

Based in Hammersmith


Nomad Foods is Europe’s leading frozen food company and one of the largest in the world ??and is home to a portfolio of iconic brands; including Birds Eye, Findus, iglo, Aunt Bessie’s and Goodfella’s. With revenues of €2.6bn and approx. 8000 employees across 22 markets and 19 factories, our aim and propose is to serve the world with better food.

With the opening of our new Shared Finance Centre - housing both our Financial Accounting teams and our Financial Planning and Analysis Centre of Expertise - this provides an outstanding place to work for finance professionals, with new and exciting opportunities to join a growing company and develop your career.


About the role


The Accounts Payable Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring that Nomad Foods maintains strong supplier relationships, accurate invoice processing, and robust financial controls. In addition to processing invoices and credit notes using Vendor Invoice Management (VIM), the Analyst is responsible for managing key supplier accounts, performing regular supplier statement reconciliations, preparing and executing weekly payment runs, undertaking month-end activities, and delivering key SOX controls.


As a system super user, the AP Analyst will act as a point of expertise for VIM and AP processes, helping resolve complex issues and supporting continuous improvement across the Procure to Pay cycle.


Invoice & Credit Note Processing

  • Process supplier invoices and credit notes accurately through VIM according to service levels
  • Investigate and resolve VIM exceptions, identifying missing or incorrect data and taking corrective actions
  • Identify recurring issues and contribute to root cause analysis and process improvements

Supplier Relationship Ownership

  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned key suppliers
  • Build and maintain strong, professional supplier relationships to ensure smooth operations and timely resolutions

Payments & Cash Management

  • Prepare, review, and execute weekly AP payment runs
  • Ensure compliance with payment authorisation matrix, controls, and treasury guidelines

Month-End Close Activities

  • Perform month-end AP activities including: AP accruals
  • GR/IR review
  • Reconciliation of key AP accounts

SOX Controls & Compliance

  • Execute and document SOX controls accurately, ensuring full audit readiness
  • Support internal and external audits with required evidence, explanations, and process walkthroughs

Complex Issue Resolution

  • Use strong AP knowledge and VIM expertise to navigate and resolve complex invoice, PO, or master data issues
  • Partner with Procurement, Receiving, Supply Chain, and IT to troubleshoot and resolve systemic or process-related problems
  • Act as an escalation point for AP Analysts and business stakeholders

System Super User Responsibilities

  • Serve as a VIM super user and AP process expert within the team
  • Support system testing, upgrades, user training, and defect resolution
  • Maintain and improve AP process documentation, SOPs, and training materials
  • Share best practices and mentor junior team members


About you

  • Strong experience in Accounts Payable, with demonstrated capability in handling complex AP issues
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) is required
  • Strong Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, data analysis)
  • Good working knowledge of AP accounting, invoice flow, and P2P processes
  • Experience performing payment runs, reconciliations, and month-end tasks
  • Knowledge of SOX controls and compliance requirements (preferred)
  • Strong communication skills and stakeholder management abilities


What we offer you


  • The potential of a varied career across different areas of finance or cross-functionally
  • A culture where your ideas make a difference
  • Hybrid working


At Nomad Foods we are proud to represent the world we serve by hiring diverse talent. Our inclusive culture is all about what we can achieve together, and valuing difference as our greatest strength. #justbeyou.
